faq.title: Everything to know before you apply

items.a: Create your account with the “Request access” button. Our team reviews your application and assigns the right level; you receive an email as soon as your access is activated.
From your profile and, if you wish, a placement test. Your teacher can adjust your level at any time and moves you up when you are ready.

In the GlobeSpeak virtual classroom, in small groups of the same level: video, chat, raised hand and reactions, right on the platform. Only students enrolled in the session can enter, from 15 minutes before it starts.

items.q: Do I need to install software?
items.a: No. A recent browser is enough, on a computer, tablet or phone. Speaking exercises require a microphone.

items.q: Can I learn at my own pace?
items.a: Yes. Lessons, videos and exercises are available at any time; your progress is saved and you pick up where you left off.
Yes. When you complete a level, you receive a certificate with a QR code that anyone can use to verify it.

help.MCQ: The student picks one correct answer.
help.LISTENING_MCQ: The student listens to an audio file, then picks the correct answer.
help.MULTI_SELECT: Several answers can be correct; all of them (and only them) must be ticked.
help.TRUE_FALSE: The student says whether the statement is true or false.
help.GAP_FILL: The student fills in the blanks; partial credit per correct blank.
help.SHORT_ANSWER: The student types the answer; case, spaces and final punctuation are ignored.
help.ORDERING: Items are shuffled; the student puts them back in the right order.
help.MATCHING: The student matches each left item with a right item; partial credit.
